title: Fixed JSON settings footer and remove image export

request.text: Vậy cho cụm 2 button này xuống bên dưới, fixed position. Bỏ tính năng export PNG đi, ko cần thiết

decision: Reuse the native settingsTransfer UI and codec in the native Panel footer via a presentation-only section projection. Remove image-export capability and export-only passes.
result: In progress; fixed native preset actions, JSON-only export, unchanged beam preview.
risks: Footer placement is an app-owned projection because the runtime settingsTransfer schema has no placement flag.
